notes.title: PATCH NEWS
notes.notes:
Hello kind fellows,

We are happy to announce some significant changes! Tomorrow comes a new patch and for the weekend we have organized not only streamers, but also Youtubers with whom you can play together!

Tomorrow in our patch we proudly present many new features, such as:

- New Leviathan Set
- T4 Gear
- Pve Monster Drop Item Changes
- A new dungeon
- And many more..

We look forward to your opinions and to our Warmonger weekend!
And of course we continue to work on new ideas and content! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/721a658fe7eb8c99946459bb75c07b13a08225b5.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix regarding fame
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/732722c46b44e62b1bc9a899326ef284b72a9b0a.png[/img]

Hello,

you get only fame now when you have finished the fight. Some people just attacked a map and left right away again and got some fame. This strategy will not working anymore.

Your,

GAMESinFLAMES Team

notes.title: Short Hotfix maintenance & PvP info
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/eadf1c6eb8778117f491eac71423538f43c4b344.jpg[/img]

Hello,

we have a short maintenance at 11:30 CET for a problem wit the medal calculation.

We will change next week something on PvP Rewards so that it will be a lot more worth doing PvP. This will be the first small (!) step of making the PvP more rewarding and more interesting. 

The plan is that you can use your Fame than for something you usually farm a lot and is needed for Runes. So Rune progression will be quicker for PvP players! And it is just the first step!

Your,

GAMESinFLAMES Team

notes.title: [Patch Log] 06.04
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/9b081e21e4e3673087bb1c9b7d2a1f19aab7dae7.png[/img]

Here are the changes applied in the latest Maintenance from the 6th of April.

[b]1. We fixed a Bug which resulted in player beeing unable to upgrade their Gear beyond T2. [/b]

Gear should now be able to succeed again during an Upgrade to T3.


[b]2. Adjusted success rates for upgrading Runes and Gear [/b]

[i]NOTE: We aknowlegde the frustration after the destruction of items during a fail and working on a better approach to solve this.[/i]

Runes:

- Success Rates are now slowly decreased based on their Level and Rarity. A higher Rarity results in an earlier rate decrease per level. The decrease per level won't extend one diget percantages.

First level of Decrease:
[list]
[*] Rarity 1 -> Level 6-7
[*] Rarity 2 -> Level 5-6
[*] Rarity 3 -> Level 4-5
[/list]
[i] Rarity of a Rune can be seen and filtered at the Rune Craftig NPC [/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/1d258884c94090ddbcc7c4ffad280c52ab0dfc8a.png[/img]

Gear:

- Success Rates are now slowly decreased based on their Tier and Rarity.
A higher Rarity results in an earlier rate decrease per Tier.
[i] Rarity of a Gear can be seen on the Item itselfe. [/i]


[b]3. Increased the Duration of all costumes from 1440 to 2610. [/b]
[i] Duration is counted in Minutes and will only count down while the item is equipped [/i]


[b]4. Bug Fixes: [/b]

- Fixed an issue where players were able to claim items of trade mails without paying the corresponding gold.

- Fixed an issue where the Failuer notifier wasn't displayed while using supplements in Rune reinforcement.


[b]5. Optimizations [/b]

- Change party member's ID color when you are a party member

- Tooltip exposure with respect to level / tax on Fortification

- Skills used through party interface targets now correctly to the related skill

notes.title: Patch Notes 2nd of April 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/732722c46b44e62b1bc9a899326ef284b72a9b0a.png[/img]

Hello,

We made today following changes:

1. Hero durability increased from 24 to 240 (We will decrease it to 120 soon. This is to compensate the short usage you had with durability 24)
2. Dungeon Opening time decreased from 20 to 15 minutes
3. Party bonus and kills are working only on the same map
4. Fixed a bug that Battle buff stayed after leaving the battle
5. Fixed a bug that Hero passives were active after Hero Crystal was removed
6. Increased Monster invasion
7. Saint weapon change (we will monitor this change closely):
			
	Magical Dash Blade		
			
		Q	AD->AP
		W	AD->AP
			
	Magical Wrath Blade		
			
		Q	AD->AP
		E	AD->AP

notes.title: Patch Notes 29th of March
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32075649/eadf1c6eb8778117f491eac71423538f43c4b344.jpg[/img]

Here are the patchnotes from todays maintenance:

Weapons Saint : 

1. Magical dash blade : 
Restriction skill now scales with AD.
Punishing charge now scales with AD.

2. Magical Wrath blade :
Blink like Wind skill now scales with AD.
Blade storm Skill now scales with AD.

3. Cash mall Updates:

-Added Ninja costume for punishers 
-Added 5000 and 10000 Yellow jewels for sale. 

4. Increased tower range

6. Increased chance of NPC invasion.

7. Chat font changes :

-Changed color of Party chat.
-Changed color of whisper chat.

9. Increased wait period after winning a war to 3 minutes before land can be invaded again.

10. Added a Confirmation dialogue when making a cash mall purchase. 

11. Added an indicator for party on minimap.

12. Increased defence and attack of Towers and nexus. 

13. Added 3 repeatable quests for Abyss at Athan (Merit merchant).

14. Decreased item drop rate in abyss
